a: Walk-ins are always welcome. We recommend booking for weekend brunch, evenings and any group of 6 or more.

q: Can you cater for allergies and dietary needs?
a: Yes. Most of the menu can be made vegetarian, vegan, gluten free or dairy free. Tell us when you book, and we’ll talk you through it on the day. We do handle nuts and gluten in our kitchen.

q: Is there a minimum spend for private dining?
a: The oak room has a minimum spend that varies by day and season. Send an enquiry and we’ll reply within one business day.

q: Do you do takeaway and online orders?
a: Yes. Order at the counter, and our beans are available to take home any time. A pre-order service is coming soon (in this fictional world).

q: Can I bring my own cup?
a: Please do. You’ll get ten cents off every drink, and our compostable cups are one less thing in landfill.
